title: Modular Shower Tray
author: fiftyfifty
description:
This tray measures 200x80mm, providing a compact yet comfortable space for your daily rituals.

To expand your shower area, you can easily add one or more additional trays.

You'll need two modular beams for each extra tray added to your setup. This system supports glass 7mm, 8mm and 10mm thick.

UPDATE 2026-02-15:

\- Added hook for 30mm

UPDATE 2025-07-19:

\- Added hook for 10mm

UPDATE 2025-07-02:

\- Added non modular tray (bottom)
